scholarships.title: Beca de la Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG) - Convocatoria 2026
scholarships.official_source: Escuela Doctoral Franco-Peruana en Ciencias de la Ingeniería y Geociencias (EDFPCIG), administrada por la Escuela de Posgrado de la PUCP

eligibility: Menor de 40 años al cierre de la postulación
Grado académico de maestro otorgado por una institución de educación superior peruana o extranjera, debidamente registrada ante la SUNEDU, en áreas contempladas en la EDFPCIG
Presentación de la documentación obligatoria de acuerdo con el numeral 3.2 de las bases
existing.eligibility_summary: Peruvian nationals under 40 years of age at the close of applications, holding a master's degree awarded by a Peruvian or foreign higher-education institution properly registered with SUNEDU, in a field covered by the EDFPCIG, and filing the full mandatory documentation.
benefits: Movilidad local (local mobility, via the stipend)
coverage: Movilidad local (local mobility, via the stipend)
requirements: Link the application to one of the priority themes: geociencias, energía, medioambiente or ciencias afines
Choose the co-tutelage or co-direction modality and supply the corresponding documentation
Use the official application Excel format and the commitment letter issued by the EDFPCIG
documents: Documentation listed in numeral 3.2 of the official bases
application_method: Apply through the PUCP School of Postgraduate Studies using the official EDFPCIG 2026 application Excel format
Submit the signed EDFPCIG commitment letter
existing.selection_notes: The official page states that applications meeting the bases' requirements are deemed apt and proceed to evaluation; the detailed assessment criteria sit in the bases document.
existing.best_fit: A Peruvian master's graduate under 40 in geosciences, energy, environmental science or a related field who can commit to a full-time three-year doctorate split between Peru and France.
existing.notes: Only one place is offered in the 2026 call. The doctoral studies are full-time and in person; exceptionally, during the three funded years the scholar may carry out other academic or research activities directly related to the doctorate, with a maximum of teaching one course. The stipend amounts are labelled 'sujeto a modificación' on the official page. Lists of past winners from 2017 to 2025 are published on the same page. Consultas: becas-posgrado@pucp.pe.
existing.duration: Three years (36 months): year 1 doctoral thesis at PUCP, year 2 one-year research stay at a French partner university of the IRD joint unit, year 3 doctoral thesis at PUCP
